name: How do I choose the right ADU builder for my project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right ADU builder for my project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right ADU builder involves researching their experience with local regulations and successful projects in your area. Look for a builder with a strong portfolio of completed ADUs, positive client testimonials, and transparent communication regarding costs and timelines. Verify their licensing and insurance. A good builder should be able to guide you through the entire process, from design to permits to construction, ensuring compliance and quality. Prioritize a builder who understands your specific needs and can deliver a project that aligns with your vision and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: To choose an ADU builder, look for experience, local expertise, a strong portfolio, and transparent communication. Verify licensing and insurance, and ensure they understand your vision.
